correctness.rationale: For iid exact-uniform complete-null p-values and rejection levels contained in the candidate region, each ADDIS-Spending state exits by rejection with probability proportional to \(\alpha(\tau-\lambda)\gamma_j\) or by advancement with probability \(\tau-\lambda\). Conditioning on the first exit gives exact survival factor \((1+\alpha\gamma_j)^{-1}\). Multiplication over states, continuity from above, elementary product/log bounds, and Euler's sinh product prove every part of the claim. The packaged checker independently verifies finite recursions and numerical values.
